title: scripts/permanent-repro.sh one-command reproduction
description:
Add `scripts/permanent-repro.sh` that runs end-to-end from a clean checkout and reproduces the benchmark artefact (S6).

## Background

Epic success criterion 9: `scripts/permanent-repro.sh` runs end-to-end. This issue lands the script — a single-command driver that builds the workspace, runs the criterion benches, runs the simulation harnesses (S1-S5 where the host can), generates the plots (T27), and writes the provenance JSON.

The script must be idempotent: running it twice in a row produces the same artefact (modulo wall-clock timestamps in the criterion JSON metadata).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `scripts/permanent-repro.sh` exists and is executable.
- [ ] [hard] Running it from a clean checkout on the dev host produces the full `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/` artefact directory end-to-end.
- [ ] [hard] The script honours environment variables for hardware-specific opts (`GF2_PERMANENT_REPRO_SKIP_GPU=1`, etc.) so non-ROCm hosts can still reproduce the CPU portion.
- [ ] [hard] Script returns non-zero on any sub-step failure; partial artefacts are not silently committed.
- [ ] [hard] Script invokes `cargo bench`, the simulation harnesses, and the T27 plot scripts in dependency order.
